content.question: Match different cases in the epsilon-greedy algorithm with expected behaviour.

answer.Epsilon set to low value: More exploitation - the agent selects the best known action more often.
answer.Epsilon set to high value: More exploration - the agent selects random actions more often.
answer.Epsilon set to 0: It will always exploit, choosing the best known action every time.
answer.Epsilon set to 1: It will always explore, choosing a random action every time.
